scripts.format: prettier --write app/src app/index.html app/vite.config.js app/capacitor.config.ts app/tsconfig.json app/tests packages server/src server/test server/*.json server/*.jsonc server/*.ts server/*.md package.json scripts docs README.md
scripts.native:sync: npm run build && npm exec -w app -- cap sync
scripts.android:build: npm run native:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npm exec -w app -- cap sync ios
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/bundle-test.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs app/tests/*.test.mjs app/tests/*.test.ts packages/core/test/*.test.ts && npm test -w server
